title: Gate a searchable indexer restart on actual health
objectives: Gate a searchable indexer restart on actual health
Refinement of the accepted AU-36–43 track; the original individual source was unavailable.

tasks.instruction: Use Automation Operations or the ansible01 virtual CLI. New starter files are explicit repository fixture additions; old seed commits remain.
Review the actual management URI preflight and factor assertions, then run v7_cluster_restart.yml with --limit cm01.
Ansible queues the searchable restart; it does not instantly complete it. Advance the operation, verify actual peer service transitions and search count=3 before declaring success.

hints: Inspect playbook source, correct target and actual run output.
Review the operation page after Ansible queues asynchronous work.
